forbidden_section_heading_preview: This account suggests that Wang studied with Li Gao many years before 1232, and that Wang may have learned Zhang Yuansu's precepts from Li rather than from Zhang himself.
Luo also revealed something that “few people knew”: “Damp Heat and Ministerial Fire make most illnesses” (濕熱 相火為病最多 人罕有知其秘者). He added:
1. The Shaanxi Danxi xinfa (1450s)
2. The Huizhou edition of the Danxi xinfa (1482)
3. The Danxi xiansheng yishu zuanyao 丹溪先生醫書纂要 (1484)
4. The Danxi xinfa fuyu 丹溪心法附餘 (Huizhou, 1536)
5. The Danxi zhifa xinyao 丹溪治法心要 (1543)
